name: River Plate under Marcelo Gallardo (2014-2019)
scopeNote: River Plate's first Gallardo cycle from his first competitive match (Copa Argentina v Ferro, Salta, 27 Jul 2014; he was appointed 6 Jun 2014 per search summary, unverified on page) to the Copa Libertadores final lost to Flamengo on 23 Nov 2019 (Lima). Style named by sources: possession-based, high-pressing attacking football with high tactical variability (4-1-3-2, 4-4-2, 4-3-1-2, 4-2-3-1, back three/five variants); Bielsa and Guardiola cited as influences. Season data from Coaches' Voice use YYYY/YY. No source found on zonal vs man-marking in open play: River's marking scheme is not established. Partial dates used where only month/season given.
openQuestions: Zonal vs man-marking in open play and set pieces not documented by any readable in-period source (a 2025-era La Pagina Millonaria snippet says River marks zonally at set pieces, out of period and unread).
Appointment date 6 Jun 2014 seen only in a search summary.
2019 Flamengo final shape not stated by sources beyond 'the usual starting eleven'; footballbh analysis returned 403.
Search summaries disagree on whether River used a back three in the 2019 final (a pre-match test) or the usual shape (Trivela says usual, no surprises).

sources.title: Big Data: El River Plate de Marcelo Gallardo - The Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: “Más allá de que también debes ser inteligente a la hora de defender, mi misión es pensar que un equipo debe tener la pelota y atacar para ganar”

sources.title: Big Data: El River Plate de Marcelo Gallardo - The Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Bajo un estilo marcado por los principios indicados en su presentación -atacar y dominar los partidos a través de la posesión de balón-, el club ganó la Copa Sudamericana 2014.

sources.title: Big Data: El River Plate de Marcelo Gallardo - The Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: En un primer período, 2014/15, apostó por dos sistemas de juego principales: 4-1-3-2 en el 29% de los partidos y 4-4-2 en un 20%. River Plate también se dispuso sobre un 4-2-3-1 (13%) y 4-3-3 (11%)

sources.title: Big Data: El River Plate de Marcelo Gallardo - The Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: En la 2016/217, el 4-4-2 tomó mayor protagonismo en los planteamientos del entrenador argentino, estando presente en un 35% de los partidos disputados. Mientras, utilizó el 4-1-3-2 en un 15% y el 4-3-3 en un 11%.

sources.title: Big Data: El River Plate de Marcelo Gallardo - The Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: en la 2017/18, el 4-3-1-2 dominó los planteamientos con un 21%, con el 4-2-3-1 en un 17%. El 4-4-2 pasó entonces a un segundo plano, solo presente en un 14% de los partidos.

sources.title: Big Data: El River Plate de Marcelo Gallardo - The Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: no dudó en jugar con una defensa de cinco en la final de la Copa Libertadores ante Boca Juniors

sources.title: Big Data: El River Plate de Marcelo Gallardo - The Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Todas esas estadísticas de disparos se basaron principalmente en ataques posicionales —claro signo de la idea de juego de Gallardo—, con un promedio de 36 de estas acciones por partido. Eso señala al River Plate como un equipo dominador, aunque no exento de contragolpe, con una media de 3 ocasiones por partido a la contra.

sources.title: Big Data: El River Plate de Marcelo Gallardo - The Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: contrasta con el 69,8 de la 2017/18, la cifra más baja de pases en último tercio de campo en la etapa de Gallardo al frente del equipo.

sources.title: Big Data: El River Plate de Marcelo Gallardo - The Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: Independiente del sistema en los momentos sin balón —variando de una defensa de cuatro o, en ocasiones, con tres centrales y dos carrileros—, el perfil ofensivo del River Plate, como es natural, marcó su franja defensiva.

sources.title: Coach watch: Marcelo Gallardo - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: the features that most consistently define his teams are the extent to which they prioritise possession, build up from the back and offer changes of pace to swiftly launch attacks. He encourages short, precise passes from defence and a gradual build through the thirds until a suitable attacking position is reached

sources.title: Coach watch: Marcelo Gallardo - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: In his first year at River Plate, he regularly organised his team into a 4-3-1-2 or 4-4-2 that was built on its defence; in 2015 that was followed by a more consistent 4-4-2 that involved a higher line, width, and their defenders guarding against counter-attacks.

sources.title: Coach watch: Marcelo Gallardo - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: when Ramiro Funes Mori and Matías Kranevitter were sold – Gallardo's recruitment has so far proved sound – and Iván Alonso, Andrés D’Alessandro and Ignacio Fernández were signed, the 4-2-3-1 they were attacking with evolved into a 4-2-2-2.

sources.title: Coach watch: Marcelo Gallardo - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: His team, strengthened by Enzo Pérez, Germán Lux and Javier Pinola, showed increased width in 2017, when they again used a 4-3-2-1, a 4-3-3 or a 4-4-2, and was also potent on the counter.

sources.title: Coach watch: Marcelo Gallardo - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: the presence of Franco Armani, Juan Fernando Quintero and Lucas Pratto led to an increased focus on possession and counter-pressing, and contributed to them eventually winning the Copa Libertadores in 2018.

sources.title: Coach watch: Marcelo Gallardo - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: When River are defending, Gallardo instructs his players to press in advanced territory, and to make quick recovery runs to regain their defensive shape following losses of possession.

sources.title: Coach watch: Marcelo Gallardo - Coaches' Voice
sources.evidence: their exact defensive system is, similarly, determined by those at his disposal, but without sacrificing their ability to protect the central areas of the pitch, often by offering increased numbers there (below, against Boca Juniors).

sources.title: Can Marcelo Gallardo take his success with River Plate to the highest levels of the European game?
sources.evidence: “One day I will be coach of River.” It was a prophecy that soon came true when the call arrived that June for the 38-year-old to replace Ramón Díaz

sources.title: Can Marcelo Gallardo take his success with River Plate to the highest levels of the European game?
sources.evidence: Gallardo is a coaching disciple of Marcelo Bielsa, whom he played under for the Argentina national team at the beginning of the 2000s, favouring a high-pressing, attacking style.

sources.title: Can Marcelo Gallardo take his success with River Plate to the highest levels of the European game?
sources.evidence: His instinct to stick with Gonzalo ‘Pity’ Martínez as his team’s playmaker after a difficult period following the player’s arrival from Huracán, when he was the target of the Monumental boo-boys, has been amply rewarded over the past two years

sources.title: Can Marcelo Gallardo take his success with River Plate to the highest levels of the European game?
sources.evidence: As River president Rodolfo D’Onofrio noted after the victory over Boca: “Gallardo not only knows football, he knows how to form excellent groups. It is not accidental that almost all of the champions of 2015 came to support the team [in Madrid].”

sources.title: Can Marcelo Gallardo take his success with River Plate to the highest levels of the European game?
sources.evidence: “I took the decision because I thought the players needed it and I needed it.” Unrepentant, he continued: “I broke a rule, I recognise it and take responsibility.”

sources.title: Can Marcelo Gallardo take his success with River Plate to the highest levels of the European game?
sources.evidence: By developing youth team graduates such as Sebastián Driussi and Emmanuel Mammana, and promising players bought in from other clubs like Lucas Alario and Marcelo Saracchi, Gallardo has brought in millions of dollars to help the club’s balance sheet.

sources.title: Can Marcelo Gallardo take his success with River Plate to the highest levels of the European game?
sources.evidence: the task of rebuilding again begins almost immediately with Martínez due to join Atlanta United in January for $17m. Spanish vultures Real Madrid and Barcelona are circling over their best youngsters, Exequiel Palacios and Gonzalo Montiel

sources.title: Is Marcelo Gallardo the next great Argentine manager?
sources.evidence: “I was born to take on big challenges,” Gallardo said at his introductory press conference.

sources.title: Is Marcelo Gallardo the next great Argentine manager?
sources.evidence: Having played under the wild genius that is Marcelo Bielsa for the national team, Gallardo attributes much of his coaching philosophy to the man who has influenced so many in the game, and he credits Pep Guardiola’s possession-based play and high pressing to win the ball as an inspiration today.

sources.title: Is Marcelo Gallardo the next great Argentine manager?
sources.evidence: In June 2014, Dr Sandra Rossi, who has a PhD in neuroscience and who has been referred to as the ‘brain trainer’, was hired at River to work with the players on neuroplasticity

sources.title: Is Marcelo Gallardo the next great Argentine manager?
sources.evidence: River started well, with a high pressing 4-3-1-2, however the speed and passing accuracy of the Barcelona attack finally wore down the press of Gallardo’s men.

sources.title: Is Marcelo Gallardo the next great Argentine manager?
sources.evidence: The Argentine sent his men on a mission to frustrate and impede the mighty 4-3-3 of Luis Enrique.

sources.title: Maidana: "Marcelo quiere un equipo agresivo y vistoso"
sources.evidence: “Quiere un fútbol vistoso, con tenencia de pelota, un equipo agresivo. Ojalá podamos pulir detalles”.

sources.title: El nuevo River sostuvo su versatilidad táctica
sources.evidence: Gallardo dispuso un esquema con cuatro defensores, tres volantes en el medio, dos sueltos y un punta, pero el dibujo fue flexible e incluso terminó usando un 4-3-3 luego de los cambios.

sources.title: El nuevo River sostuvo su versatilidad táctica
sources.evidence: el 4-2-3-1 dejó para rescatar la identidad de siempre: una intención de tener el control del juego, ser protagonista y recuperar el balón rápidamente.

sources.title: El nuevo River sostuvo su versatilidad táctica

sources.evidence: el equipo de Marcelo Gallardo, que hoy no estuvo en el banco, justificó la victoria a partir del peso colectivo, del juego asociado, de la apertura del campo cuando un rival cansado, y con uno menos, no tenía otra alternativa que esperar a que llegaran los penales.
